WITH country_averages AS (
  SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM circuits c
  JOIN races r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY c.country
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM country_averages
), above_overall AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins
  FROM country_averages ca
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.avg_wins
), group_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM above_overall
), selected AS (
  SELECT aa.avg_wins
  FROM above_overall aa
  CROSS JOIN group_average ga
  WHERE aa.avg_wins > ga.avg_wins
)
SELECT AVG(s.avg_wins) AS mean_country_average_wins,
       AVG(s.avg_wins - o.avg_wins) AS mean_excess_overall_average,
       AVG(s.avg_wins - ga.avg_wins) AS mean_excess_over_above_group_average
FROM selected s
CROSS JOIN overall o
CROSS JOIN group_average ga;
